resolution.summary: kobuki_qtestsuite stops subclassing the backend MatDataPlot and hands PlotWidget.switch_data_plot_widget the provider's wrapper instead ('from rqt_plot.data_plot import DataPlot'; DataPlot(self._plot_widget)), reproducing the fixed battery range with the wrapper's API (set_autoscale(y=False); set_ylim([0, 180])) and dropping the reset() call and FullSizeDataPlot import in gyro_drift_frame.py (kobuki_desktop 5ee65b06, 6df4bd7e, 55e84a61).
resolution.evidence: "Battery profiling now has fixed y scale [0, 180]. and gyro looks fine too." (jihoonl, 2014-08-11, https://github.com/yujinrobot/kobuki_desktop/issues/33#issuecomment-51742356), posted when closing the issue after 55e84a61; the rqt_plot in /opt/ros/indigo on that date is still release 0.3.8 (0.3.9 was tagged 2014-08-18).
